name: Google Cloud Professional Machine Learning Engineer

third_party_evaluations.summary: Designs, builds, and productionizes ML models on Google Cloud.

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced professional: 3. The ordered median is professional. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: Production ML design and delivery with a three-year profile support professional domain responsibility; modern AI relevance does not itself evidence expert security or governance competence.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: Building and productionizing ML systems with a three-year profile supports professional GCP ML engineering knowledge. The record does not establish a security-focused practical, so it is not by itself evidence of advanced AI-security capability.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded design and productionization of ML systems supports professional engineering knowledge at a three-year level. Modern attack-surface relevance helps, but neither general AI novelty nor an unspecified exam proves expert AI-security capability.
